purpose: Stage-3 paired edit-mode baseline: the LCI semantic-navigation arm vs the lexical grep/glob/read arm, both now producing a patch, scored by the all-three-gates conjunction (behaviour AND convention AND blast-radius) over the committed 24-task edit bank. Informational baseline: it pins and instruments the grid and accounts for every cell; it does NOT gate a merge and reports no LCI-vs-baseline effect, because the paid grid was never launched.

gates.definition: A cell counts toward the headline only when ALL THREE named gates pass on the agent's captured patch.
gates.fail_closed: An absent gate is a FAIL (REASON_GATE_ABSENT), never an unknown or a pass.

harness.isolation_gate: runner.gate.enforce (tool_not_allowed / path_escape / sealed_path); Bash denied on both arms

scorer.judge: none (deterministic behaviour/blast/convention gates; no LLM judge)

task_bank.adjudication: each task carries two annotator verdicts (ann-hyde, ann-quill) in edits/annotations/, resolved
task_bank.task_digest_recipe: task_digest.task_digest(canonical sort_keys JSON of full task)

forge.note: Edit-mode corpora are the same forged, adjudicated trees as the stage-1 exploration bank; the edit bank adds the mutation goal prompts, oracle_patch, behaviour/blast/convention rubrics and dual annotator adjudication on top.

subject_binary.name: lci
subject_binary.invocation: lci mcp (stdio), registered as server 'lci' via --mcp-config; baseline arm attaches no MCP server

treatment.description: LCI MCP semantic tools + Read + mutation (Edit/Write)

baseline.description: Lexical Grep + Glob + Read + mutation (Edit/Write); no LCI server attached

arms.single_variable: model, system prompt, timeout, pinned clean checkout and the goal prompt are byte-identical across arms; only the navigation toolset (LCI MCP + Read vs Glob/Grep + Read) differs.

model.note: Harness default (exploration_runner.DEFAULT_MODEL), arm-shared by BOTH arms. A paid run requires this be an explicitly approved model id (verified against the live provider), not the unattended default.

repetitions.note: The committed bank is authored and adjudicated at a single corpus seed (7). A repetition is a distinct (task, arm, seed) cell in the scorer's key, so >=3 independent replications require re-forging AND re-adjudicating seeds 8, 9 ... which no committed bank yet provides. Variance-powered replication (>=3 reps, spread, minimum-successes gate) is therefore a documented PREREQUISITE of any threshold claim, not a config field that can be flipped.

budget.note: 48 = 24 tasks x 2 arms x seed 7 (reps per_cell = 1). A spending cap was never set because no paid run was authorized (see approval).

approval.reason: This stage-3 configuration was pinned by an unattended implementer session. The task's own blocker list requires 'explicit paid-run configuration signoff' before launch: a named human approving the model and the spending/time budget, recorded before launch. No approver was present and no provider credentials are configured on this host (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN unset). Per design-unbiased-benchmarks stop conditions, an unapproved/uncapable paid grid must not be launched, and its auth failures must not be scored as answers.

execution.reason: paid_run_approval_not_granted; provider credentials not configured on this host
execution.omission_policy: No live paid ledger exists, so the paid run-records.jsonl is empty. Every one of the 48 planned (task, arm, seed) cells is enumerated in aggregate.json completeness.missing and bucketed as missing_cell in the failure breakdown -- present as a planned cell carrying an explicit missing status, none silently dropped. A not-executed record is deliberately NOT fabricated, because edit_scorer._STATUS_FAILURE has no not_executed mapping and would mis-bucket a governance decision as a harness failure; the missing_cell bucket is the scorer's purpose-built not-run path.
execution.resume_semantics: The runner is resume-idempotent per cell keyed on (task_id::arm::seed, task_digest): a COMPLETED cell is never re-run or duplicated; only retryable classes (timeout, agent_failure, config_error, harness_failure) re-run on a resume. Because zero cells were observed, a later approved run appends 48 fresh cells; nothing is skipped or reused from this pinned state.

hermetic_pipeline_smoke.scope: one task, both arms, deterministic fake agent, trivial argv behaviour command, real runner/gates/scorer/aggregate; no provider, no toolchain, byte-stable
hermetic_pipeline_smoke.evidence: both arms reach edit_passed (all three gates green), completeness passed, headline rate 1.0 over 2 planned cells

guarded_live_smoke.reason: not opted in (requires --live / EXPLORATION_RUNNER_LIVE=1 AND a resolvable claude CLI AND the lci binary)
guarded_live_smoke.evidence: the paid-launch smoke path is fail-closed: it refuses to spend credentials unless explicitly opted in and capable. This is the 'no silent paid run' guard.

stages.stage1_exploration: COMPLETE (informational): pinned + fully materialised + 0 executed for the same approval reason. Report: benchmarks/repo-qa/ANALYSIS-exploration-stage1.md
stages.stage2_claim_validation: PENDING: instrument present (exploration/scoring/claim_validation.py, scripts/score_claim_validation.py, claim-run/claim-smoke subcommands); no committed stage-2 baseline ledger or report exists yet. Per the task's blocking clause, stage-2 is integrated as PENDING and does not block the stage-3 baseline.

out_of_scope: threshold selection / merge gates on LCI-vs-baseline deltas (no variance support yet)
variance-powered replication (>=3 independent seeds, spread, significance)
